title: Çamlıca Mosque
scope: Standing Çamlıca Mosque above Üsküdar, opened in 2019, with the six minarets, central prayer hall, domed courtyard colonnades and central ablution pavilion.
limitations: The main 34 m roof and six 107.1 m or 90 m minarets use documented dimensions. Spacing and footprints follow the native map. Subordinate semi-domes, arcades, fenestration, terrace, colors, finish and ornamental detail are approximate.

The original published Qualla view is distant. Exterior detail is derived from factual records and the mapped geometry. The below-terrace museum interior, underground garage, subway, detached visitor facilities and interior calligraphy are outside scope.
